acceptanceCriteria: A journaled relocation (for example corvint-tasks relocate --from OLD --request-id ID) run from the new primary worktree re-pins head.primaryWorktree, records a receipt naming both paths, and refuses while any attempt is live or the dispatcher runs.
Alternatively or additionally, an archive export/restore round trip into a fresh store at a new path is documented and tested.
Operator docs state that the store, dispatch config and evidence directory must sit on real paths with no symlink component.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1557 (main 147a518 / 6e90476, macOS). Moving a workspace makes every command fail with UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM (head.primaryWorktree differs from the resolved primary worktree; relocation unsupported). A symlink at the old path is refused ('symlink in the resolved path'; dispatch config 'openat evidence: not a directory'). Recovery needed moving everything back. Related: V1-1461 (copied store unreadable off its original path).
title: GH #1557: a task store cannot be relocated to another directory, and symlinked paths are refused
